categories.main_business_segments: Koshidaka Holdings operates three main business segments: (1) Karaoke, which includes the operation of karaoke box stores under the 'Karaoke Manekineko' and 'Onekara' brands in Japan and overseas; (2) Real Estate Management, which involves the ownership and leasing of commercial properties; and (3) Other Businesses, such as the operation of bathhouses and food and beverage outlets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages its expertise in multi-store operations, efficient store management, and digital transformation (DX) initiatives, including the development and deployment of the 'E-bo' entertainment platform in karaoke rooms. It also utilizes energy-efficient equipment, advanced POS systems, and standardized operational manuals to ensure consistent service quality and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Koshidaka primarily serves general consumers seeking entertainment and leisure, with a focus on young adults, families, and groups. Its main markets are the Japanese domestic leisure and entertainment sector, with growing presence in overseas markets such as South Korea, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, where it operates over 700 karaoke stores nationwide. Internationally, it has expanded into South Korea, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia, with a total of 25 overseas stores as of August 2025. The vast majority of revenue and assets are concentrated in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Koshidaka operates at the downstream end of the supply chain, directly providing entertainment services to end customers through its owned and operated retail locations. It also manages some upstream activities in real estate by owning and leasing properties.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is focused on expanding its store network, enhancing the functionality and content of its karaoke rooms (transforming them into Private Entertainment Rooms), and accelerating digital transformation through platforms like 'E-bo.' R&D efforts are directed toward new entertainment content, digital solutions, and operational efficiency, as well as sustainability initiatives such as energy conservation and renewable energy adoption.
categories.revenue_model: The primary revenue model is direct sales of karaoke room usage and related food and beverage services to customers. Additional revenue streams include real estate leasing income and sales from bathhouse and restaurant operations. The company also receives exclusive sales commissions and promotional fees from beverage suppliers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other large karaoke chains such as Big Echo (Daiichikosho) and Joysound (XING/Standard). Koshidaka is positioned as one of Japan’s leading karaoke operators, distinguished by its aggressive store expansion, innovative service offerings, and strong brand recognition, particularly with 'Manekineko.'
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending August 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 69.4 billion yen, with operating profit of 11.4 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 5.26 billion yen. The company has demonstrated strong post-pandemic recovery and steady growth, with a 9.7% year-on-year increase in sales and continued expansion in both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Koshidaka emphasizes affordable, accessible, and innovative entertainment experiences, with a focus on private, safe, and flexible usage of karaoke rooms. Its differentiation lies in the breadth of its store network, the introduction of new entertainment content and digital platforms, and a commitment to sustainability and customer-centric service. The company also highlights its ability to adapt to changing consumer needs and to provide a wide range of entertainment options beyond traditional karaoke.
